answer_1.quote: We evaluate the collected corpora both in terms of how diverse each sub-corpus is as well as performance on two downstream tasks: conversation emotion classification and dialogue generation.

answer_2.quote: We report on both mean and median length of model responses. Distinct-1 and Distinct-2 measure the proportion of unigrams and bigrams respectively in the set of model responses which are unique. We also report diversity of the generated responses calculated by the metrics used in sub c collection (see Table ).
